limitations: Not a full repository gate or independent acceptance run; no native oracle execution.
All baseline src/**/*.ts are included because the actual tsconfig.build.json includes them; no minimal dependency closure claim.
No public xan export/aggregate registration is added.
Integrity checks re-enumerate files, detecting additions as well as changes/deletions at checkpoints; not a concurrent mutation sandbox.

exclusions.rule: Only the 211 baseline TypeScript build inputs and four exact package/config files; documents and data are not TypeScript build inputs. Missing dependencies remain build errors, never live-source fallback.

classification: INITIAL_BASELINE_ONLY_PROOF; historical capture; candidate runtime and moved consumer not yet executed
manifestIdentityDefinition: SHA256(JSON.stringify(records)), preserving array order and object key order shown in each record
toolAuthentication: Installed bytes individually SHA256-bound; versions checked against exact baseline lock. lockIntegrity is recorded metadata, not a claim of freshly downloaded registry tarball SRI verification.
